# Good Enough Computing in Science (GECS) 🎶🎵

**Verse 1**
We don't need a thousand cores,
Just to open twenty doors.
Not every script must break the scale,
Sometimes simple never fails.

Write it clean, make it clear,
Future-you will thank you next year.
One good plot can change your mind,
Science leaves the bugs behind.

**Pre-Chorus**
Optimize when you must,
But don't optimize on trust.
First make sure the code is right,
Then make it run through every night.

**Chorus**
♪ Good Enough Computing in Science! ♪
Finding the balance between speed and compliance.
Elegant, simple, reproducible too,
Making discoveries starts with what you do.

♪ Good Enough Computing in Science! ♪
No unnecessary appliance.
Less is more when the answer is true—
GECS is the way for me and you!

---

**Verse 2**
Version control has got your back,
No more "final_final" stack.
Document the things you've done,
Helping everyone.

Test your code before you boast,
Coffee powers every host.
Random seeds are set with care,
Now your results can all compare.

**Bridge**
It's not about perfection,
Or squeezing every FLOP.
It's building tools that others trust,
And knowing when to stop.

Repeatability, clarity,
They're worth much more than speed.
Because tomorrow's breakthrough starts
With today's well-written README.

---

**Final Chorus**
♪ Good Enough Computing in Science! ♪
From notebooks all the way to giant clusters' alliance.
Think before you parallelize,
Keep your workflow organized.

♪ Good Enough Computing in Science! ♪
Reliable is our compliance.
Code that's shared and understood,
Not just clever—simply good!

**Outro**
So raise your laptop, raise your tea,
Commit your code responsibly.
Debug together, learn as one—
That's how great science gets done!

**(GECS! GECS! Good Enough Computing in Science!)**
